entries.subtitle: Come and sit down. Here is where we are and when we are open.
entries.body:
## Getting here
We are at 123 Example Street, Sample City. There is street parking nearby and a small car park behind the building.

## Opening hours
Open every day, 11:00 to 23:00. Sunday: brunch 10:00 to 15:30, dinner 18:00 to 22:30.
